mines.mine_notes: 100% owned via Sotkamo Silver Oy. Underground silver mine, Kainuu, Finland. 2025: milled 425,000 t (−14% y/y) at average silver head grade 71 g/t (2024: 89 g/t). Production in concentrates: 803,077 oz Ag, 1,829 oz Au, 602 t Pb, 1,472 t Zn. Revenue SEK393M (−5% y/y), EBITDA SEK80M (margin 20%), EBIT SEK9M. Ore reserves (JORC, 31 Dec 2025) 1.598 Mt; measured+indicated resources 9.1 Mt; total resources 12.7 Mt (silver equivalent content 91 g/t Ag). Reserves/resources estimated to support ≥10 years of operation (through at least 2035). Revenue → ~$40.8M at avg 2025 USD/SEK 9.64.

notes: Single-mine silver producer. No AISC or cash cost per ounce disclosed in the annual report. Company extended loan maturities and converted debt to equity in 2025; new mining contractor starts 1 Jan 2026. 2026 focus: infill drilling to grow reserves in depth direction and developing western mineralisation (Project WEST). Neighbouring exploration rights in Kainuu held.
